items.name: Flint & Tinder
items.effect: Needed to light a fire, or a torch, candle, or lantern.
items.description: A small kit containing flint and tinder, used to start fires.

items.name: Lamp Oil
items.effect: Ten doses. One dose feeds an oil lamp or lantern for a shift.
items.description: A small jug of oil used to fuel lamps and lanterns.

items.name: Lantern
items.effect: Lights 10 meters around for a shift. Roll D8 each stretch; a 1 means it has gone out and wants refilling.
items.description: A metal lantern that can be used to light a small area.

items.name: Oil Lamp
items.effect: Lights 10 meters around for a shift. Roll D6 each stretch; a 1 means it has gone out and wants refilling.
items.description: A small oil lamp that can be used to light a small area.

items.name: Tallow Candle
items.effect: Lights 4 meters around for a shift. Roll D4 each stretch; a 1 means it has gone out.
items.description: A small candle made of tallow, used to provide light.

items.name: Torch
items.effect: Lights 4 meters around for a shift, or serves as a weapon. Roll D6 each stretch; a 1 means it has gone out.
items.description: A wooden stick with a cloth soaked in oil at one end, used to provide light.
